Trump says US will not attack Iran before Nov. 3 midterms; 'productive discussions' with Iran
Tanker Acers struck by multiple projectiles, first attack in weeks deep inside Persian Gulf

Ukraine attacks Salavat and Omsk refineries; Volgograd offline after early-October strike
France to release 10 million barrels of diesel; G7 to speed stock draws; IEA backs prioritized diesel release
US SPR sour crude release announced

themes.summary: Hormuz transits about 20-22 a day and attacks widened to Gulf of Oman and Arabian Gulf, though Middle East crude exports were reported at 18.2 million b/d on a 7-day average to Oct. 3.

themes.theme: Dated Brent physical premium and backwardation
themes.summary: Dated Brent at $132.585/b was $27.865/b above ICE front-month futures, with steep Brent CFD and futures backwardation pressuring prompt differentials.
VLCC, Suezmax and Aframax rates at records closed US-Asia arbitrage and pushed West African and Med sweet differentials lower while hull and cargo insurance rose 40x and 30x.
Isaias, Category 3, shut in 1.459 million boe/d (72%) of Gulf output and threatens Mobile-area refining and shipping.

themes.theme: Diesel tightness and Russian diesel deal
themes.summary: Diesel cracks fell after Trump's Russian diesel announcement and GL 135 but diesel stays tight with half of Russian refining offline and diesel export ban in place.
G7/IEA stock draws including France's 10 million barrels of diesel and a US SPR sour tender add supply while Asia works on stockpile programs.

themes.theme: Russia sanctions and Ukrainian refinery strikes
themes.summary: UK sanctioned more Russian oil firms and tankers and Ukraine struck Salavat and Omsk, while several Russian refineries restarted.
Trump said no attack on Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms while reports of Pentagon strike preparations had lifted crude overnight.
